# Organization & Brand Identity
- Brand Name: Lahore Bouquet
- Business Type: Independent Florist — Flower Delivery Service across Lahore (delivery-only, no walk-in storefront)
- Website: https://lahorebouquet.com
- Service Area: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan (DHA, Gulberg, Bahria Town, Model Town, Johar Town, Cantt, Askari, Wapda Town, Township, Faisal Town, Garden Town, Valencia, Lake City)
- Contact: +92 310 4225974 (Voice & WhatsApp), flowerbouquet@gmail.com
- Opening Hours: Monday to Sunday, 09:00 AM – 01:00 AM PKT
- Price Range: Rs. 1,180 – Rs. 35,000

# Core Offerings & Services
1. Fresh Hand-Tied Bouquets: Imported Dutch red, pink, white roses, golden sunflowers, oriental lilies, chrysanthemum bunches.
2. Custom Currency / Money Bouquets: Genuine State Bank of Pakistan banknotes carefully arranged with fresh roses.
3. Keepsake Florals: Handmade eternal crochet flower bouquets and naturally preserved everlasting dried botanical stems.
4. Bakery Cakes & Gourmet Gift Combos: Fresh chocolate fudge, red velvet, lotus three-milk cakes, and Ferrero Rocher chocolate bouquets.
5. Cultural Floristry: Handcrafted fresh motia and rose petal Gajray, mehndi flower jewellery sets, and wedding stage garlands.
6. Fragrances: Branded designer perfumes and hand-poured soy wax botanical candles.
7. Wedding & Event Décor: Fresh rose bridal car decoration, bridal room canopy / masehri flower arrangements, and corporate reception florals.

# Key Business Policies
- WhatsApp Photo Verification: A photograph of every arrangement is sent to the customer on WhatsApp before dispatch.
- Same-Day Express Delivery: Orders delivered within 2 to 5 hours across all Lahore zones.
- Midnight Surprise Slot: 11:30 PM to 12:15 AM delivery available for birthdays and anniversaries (advance booking required).
- Accepted Payment Methods: Cash on Delivery (COD), Online Bank Transfer, JazzCash, and EasyPaisa.
